title: Expedite the TR module by fly-away kit
action: Raise the requisition to priority 01 and send a courier to collect the TR module from FLC Harborview.
rationale: The part is the next domino. Arriving in 4 days leaves time for the 36 h install before TIDEWATCH.

title: Borrow a qualified SR-7 tech from USS Marrow Point
action: Request temporary duty for ET1 G. Sorensen from USS Marrow Point (fictional) to cover the SR-7 watch bill.
rationale: Restores 3 of 3 required SR-7 techs after the two transfers.
externalApproval: Needs USS Marrow Point CO concurrence

person.name: ET1 G. Sorensen (TAD)
person.note: Temporary duty from USS Marrow Point

title: Ask the fleet scheduler for a 48 h slip of TIDEWATCH
action: Send a schedule-change request to move TIDEWATCH back 2 days.
rationale: More time before the transit gives the part a chance to arrive and be installed.

title: Defer ET2 Reyes's transfer by 30 days
action: Request a 30-day delay of ET2 M. Reyes's transfer orders.
rationale: Keeps a third qualified SR-7 tech aboard through both missions.

title: Do and sign the GTG-1 monthly PMS check
action: Run the overdue monthly check on GTG-1 and sign the engineering log.
rationale: Clears the records conflict and removes a small risk on ship's power.

title: Expedite the towed array tow cable
action: Raise the tow cable requisition to priority 02 and ship by air.
rationale: Gets the towed array back to full depth before DEEP LANTERN with time to spare.

title: Take the winch brake band from tender stock
action: Request the brake band from the tender's stock during the pier period.
rationale: Fixes RAS station 3 well before replenishment.
